name: Tabriz Historic Bazaar Complex
description: Tabriz Bazaar, in northwestern Iran's Eastern Azerbaijan province, is a maze of linked brick halls, domed chambers, courtyards and covered lanes where traders have sold carpets, spices, gold and more for centuries. Once a major stop on the Silk Road, it is among the most complete traditional market systems in Iran. Wandering its shaded passages is like walking through a city within the city.
